records.name: Fletcher Street Urban Riding Club
records.summary: A nonprofit riding club on Fletcher Street in the Strawberry Mansion area of North Philadelphia. It serves young people from across the city, teaching them to ride and to care for horses.
records.what_you_do: Learn to ride, feed, groom and care for horses, and take part in club life such as classes, events and weekend rides to equine campgrounds for active members.

schedule.text: The pages we read do not list riding days or times. Ask through the member information request form.

cost.text: A 2025 news report said riding is free for kids and families. The club's own site asks for donations and does not state a fee.

first_step.how: Fill out the member information request form on the club's website. The club says it reviews each request and follows up within one week.
first_step.basis: The only way in is an application. The form asks for a parent or guardian and the child's details, approval is not guaranteed, and applicants under 18 meet by video with a parent or guardian and board members.
first_step.what_to_expect: The first step is an application, and applicants under 18 have a virtual meeting with a parent or guardian and board members before they join. Riders are placed by skill level, from beginner to advanced, and members also feed, groom and bond with the horses. The pages we read do not give session length or fees.
first_visit_tips: Send the member information request form first, since the club says approval is not guaranteed.
If you want to help with the barn instead, the site has a separate volunteer registration form.
While an application is pending, minors may come to the stables only with a parent or legal guardian.

records.notes: The cost and last sign of life come from the tier 1 CBS report, which was not re-read in this pass. The news page has no dated items from recent years (only an undated statement and a 2014 residency note). Riding days and times are not published on the pages read. The member form asks for a child's grade from 1 to 12, so the club serves children; no minimum age is stated. The form was read only and not submitted. Newcomer rating lowered from 3 to 2 because the form is an application with review. Dropped the tier 1 contact_name, which repeated the club name.
